voice.speaker: leiodes
voice.caption: I cannot bend it. Let another try. But I tell you, this bow will take the life and the breath out of the best men here, and better to die than live on failing at what we came for.
One after another the men strain, sweat, and fail.

voice.speaker: melanthius
voice.caption: Melanthius lights a fire and brings fat so the bow can be warmed and greased.

voice.speaker: eurymachus
voice.caption: Even Eurymachus cannot string it and suffers humiliation.

voice.speaker: eurymachus
voice.caption: It is not the marriage. It is the shame.

voice.speaker: antinous
voice.caption: Antinous postpones the contest for Apollo's festival feast.

keys.beat: Leiodes cannot bend the bow and prophesies death.
One after another the men strain, sweat, and fail.
Melanthius lights a fire and brings fat so the bow can be warmed and greased.
Even Eurymachus cannot string it and suffers humiliation.
Antinous postpones the contest for Apollo's festival feast.
